name: pg_int4_integer_char_overflow
subject: Fix integer to_char() overflow with V format
goal:
to_char(int4, format) can overflow while applying a `V` scaling pattern, leading to platform-dependent output instead of the normal integer range error.

Exercise values around the int32 boundaries with formats such as `V9`, `9V999999999`, and multipliers at and beyond ten decimal places, including negative inputs. A representable scaled value must format correctly; any unrepresentable int4 product must raise `integer out of range`. Formatting without `V`, and supported numeric and int8 variants, must be unchanged.
